deployment: Core development · single PostgreSQL host · no high availability

components.label: Banking application
components.purpose: Role-aware customer, operations, analytics and engineering workspaces.
components.tradeoff: One React application keeps navigation coherent. Backend remains the permission boundary.

components.label: FastAPI core
components.purpose: Authorize commands, enforce idempotency and lock funds before posting.
components.outputs: Atomic payment, ledger and outbox writes
components.tradeoff: Modular monolith reduces distributed transaction boundaries. Extraction requires evidence.

components.label: PostgreSQL ledger
components.purpose: Authoritative accepted commands, available funds and immutable balanced postings.
components.outputs: Booked account state and source events
components.tradeoff: Locks serialize hot accounts. A single host is recoverable, not highly available.

components.label: Transactional outbox
components.purpose: Persist immutable versioned payment snapshots with their business transaction.
components.tradeoff: Polling is small and observable; retains source history and adds database read load.

components.label: Durable worker
components.purpose: Archive before acknowledgement, validate, reconcile and publish versioned models.
components.tradeoff: Bounded batches; idempotent effects. No broker or node-failure guarantee.

components.label: Bronze archive
components.purpose: Preserve original envelopes, checksum, source sequence, receipt and ingestion run.
components.tradeoff: PostgreSQL prototype, not object storage or Delta. Raw records are not exposed by the API.

components.label: Silver projections
components.purpose: Retain event history; select highest aggregate version; validate lifecycle and return totals.
components.outputs: Current payment snapshots and preserved history
components.tradeoff: New source version is not a new payment. Full replay is simple but grows with history.

components.label: Gold publication
components.purpose: Daily instruction/return activity, independent source controls and last-good publication.
components.outputs: Version, cutoff, refresh time and daily facts
components.tradeoff: Daily instruction activity is not settled cash flow. No SCD2 without a history question.

components.label: Approved serving API
components.purpose: Serve published aggregates to authorized staff with honest freshness.
components.tradeoff: Customer balances always use operational accounts, never analytical aggregates.

components.label: Debezium → Kafka
components.purpose: Future CDC/streaming profile, introduced through a single-publisher cutover.
components.tradeoff: Replication lag and retained WAL growth need tested alerts and recovery.

components.label: Spark + Delta Lake
components.purpose: Target medallion lakehouse on durable object storage.
components.tradeoff: Java, Spark and object storage exceed the basic profile. Compatibility is reviewed before pinning.

components.label: Airflow orchestration
components.purpose: Schedule dependent batch, reconciliation and bounded backfill jobs.
components.tradeoff: Omitted while one durable worker owns the single pipeline; no competing scheduler.
